replaces.idea: A thick quartz barrier wall on a base with a glowing cyan bead embedded halfway through its face.
A glass-walled laboratory wave tank on four stubby legs with a brass crank and a standing cyan ripple inside.
A brass-mounted crystal prism on a pedestal with a tiny upper shelf holding a lifted cyan bead.
A domed glass LED diode standing on two wire leads, glowing with a single bright cyan spark at its tip.

new.name: Phantom Wall
new.depicts: A squat, thick rectangular stone-and-quartz barrier block standing on a flat base, with a glowing cyan bead embedded halfway through its side.
new.focal: the cyan bead emerging from the solid wall face

new.name: Ripple Tank
new.depicts: A wide glass-walled laboratory water tank on four stubby legs, with a brass hand-crank on the left and a frozen stepped cyan standing wave inside.
new.focal: the stepped cyan standing wave inside the glass tank

new.name: Promotion Prism
new.depicts: A small brass-mounted crystal prism on a pedestal with a tiny upper shelf holding a lifted cyan bead.
new.focal: the glowing cyan bead perched on the upper shelf

new.name: Recombination Diode
new.depicts: A tiny domed glass LED bulb standing on two wire leads, glowing with a single bright cyan spark at its tip.
new.focal: the bright cyan spark inside the glass dome

new.name: Fermi Sight-Glass
new.depicts: A vertical glass level-gauge tube mounted in brass end-caps, half-filled with dark cyan fluid and marked with a bright horizontal meniscus.

new.name: Dopant Shaker
new.depicts: A tiny faceted glass salt-shaker with a perforated silver cap, holding a pinch of pale-blue impurity crystals.

new.name: Avalanche Fuse
new.depicts: A short ceramic-and-glass cartridge fuse standing upright in two brass clips, with a jagged cyan arc bridged inside.
new.focal: the jagged cyan arc inside the glass tube

rework.redesign: Redraw as a two-tier semiconductor viaduct bench with a lower valence deck and an upper conduction deck separated by a physical gap and linked by five vertical glass elevator tubes holding glowing carrier beads.
